Instructions by the director: Grounded in the Comparison framework, this mid-funnel consideration ad targets the Upgrade and Optimization archetype by proving why this beautifully designed device is superior to the clinical norm. The layout is a high-contrast side-by-side split. The left side shows a dull, clinical, and blurry background depicting an old-fashioned, generic medical inhaler, labeled 'The Old Way' in soft Nunito Sans. The right side features a bright, clean, studio-lit shot of our sleek, two-tone teal and slate-gray device standing proudly upright against a pure white background, labeled 'The New Way' in bold Poppins. The metallic silver bottom of the canister glints under the studio lights, emphasizing high-quality craftsmanship. The clear headline, 'Sleek design. Zero clinical clunkiness.' is centered at the top in high-contrast black. The single, confident call to action is 'See the difference.' To keep the creative on-brand, ensure sharp visual lines, clean division of space, robust geometric typography, and plenty of breathing room around the product imagery.

Product appearance: This handheld, L-shaped metered-dose inhaler consists of a two-tone plastic actuator housing an inverted, pressurized cylindrical metal canister. At the topmost point, the flat, circular silver metallic bottom of the canister is visible, nested within a matching teal-blue rim. The actuator’s upper vertical body is a bright teal-blue matte plastic sleeve textured with fine, closely spaced vertical grip ridges wrapping around its circumference. This blue sleeve connects directly to a contrasting slate-gray, matte-finished lower plastic elbow, which curves smoothly forward into an integrated, rounded mouthpiece designed to fit the mouth. The device is compact and pocket-sized, characterized by its distinct gray-and-teal color blocking and smooth, injection-molded plastic construction with no visible logos, text, or labeling on the shown side.

Design requirements (apply to this ad):

- Make the ad design, layout, typography on-branded, but should look premium, editorial-like.
- Establish a clear visual hierarchy: one dominant focal point the eye lands on
  first, then the supporting message, then the CTA.
- Keep strong figure/ground contrast. If text sits over imagery, place a scrim or
  overlay behind it so it stays fully legible.
- Place the focal subject on a rule-of-thirds line; leave generous whitespace and
  avoid clutter.
- Use a limited palette anchored to the brand colors (~60-30-10), reserving one
  accent color for the call to action.
- Keep 20% space all around the creative for the ad to look cleaner
- Group and align elements cleanly (Gestalt); use at most two type styles.

Instructions by the director: Grounded in the Visual Metaphor framework, this bottom-of-funnel purchase ad appeals to the Impulse and Discovery archetype through high-energy, vibrant, and appetizing color contrast. The visual hero is the product itself, shown in a dynamic close-up. The teal-blue and slate-gray inhaler is captured at an angle, suspended mid-air against a solid, vibrant Goli Red background. Micro-droplets of water coat the textured vertical ridges of the teal sleeve, visually representing freshness, purity, and immediate relief. The bright silver canister bottom at the top of the device catches a sharp, premium highlight. The short, punchy headline, 'Aesthetic wellness that just clicks.' is positioned cleanly at the top in bold white Poppins. A high-contrast, rectangular black CTA button with slightly rounded corners is centered at the bottom, reading 'SHOP NOW' in bold white text. To keep the ad on-brand, leverage Goli's signature red, clean modern minimalist composition, and bold geometric sans-serif fonts, keeping text elements under 15% of the total layout.

Instructions by the director: Grounded in the AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) framework, this top-of-funnel discovery ad captures the aspirational Desire and Identity archetype by positioning the daily medical essential as a curated personal accessory. The visual hero is the outcome of an elevated lifestyle, featuring a minimalist flat-lay on a premium, light-textured white marble surface. The pocket-sized inhaler, with its vibrant teal-blue textured sleeve and sleek slate-gray mouthpiece, is styled naturally alongside other high-end daily essentials like a designer leather cardholder, minimal brass keys, and a modern smartphone. The lighting is soft and natural, casting elegant shadows that emphasize the premium matte texture of the device's injection-molded plastic. The headline, 'Elevate your everyday essentials,' is set in bold black Poppins in the top-left corner, taking up less than 10% of the image. The single call to action is a soft 'Explore the collection.' To keep the ad on-brand, maintain a pristine white and neutral gray background color palette, ensuring high contrast, clean minimalist spacing, and modern, geometric typography consistent with the brand guide.
